title: Florida channel wakes up with an unexplained metal filling

tellings.quote: behold, he wakes up when he realizes he has a metal filling that he never had.

plain: A man in Florida in the early 1970s is said to have woken up and found a metal filling in his tooth that he never had. He was a "channel", someone who says he passes on messages from non-human beings, and he worked in the circle around the medium Phyllis Schlemmer and the researcher Andrija Puharich. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this on the show, drawing on the book The Stargate Conspiracy, and the story suggests something had worked on the man while he slept.
